description: This file defines middleware for error handling within an ASP.NET Core application. It intercepts exceptions during HTTP request processing and returns appropriate JSON error responses, including support for localized messages and custom exception types.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for catching and handling exceptions in HTTP request pipeline, serializing error responses, and supporting localization and logging.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Entry point for the middleware, invokes the next delegate and catches exceptions to handle them appropriately.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Private static method that processes exceptions, sets appropriate HTTP status codes, serializes error messages, and writes the response.
